name: std::chrono::month_day_last::month_day_last
intro: Constructs a month_day_last object that represents the last day of the month m.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: A more convenient way to construct a month_day_last is with operator/, e.g., std::chrono::April/std::chrono::last.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Represent a valid calendar component or date in March 2024, then convert it to text.
